responsibility: This machine-description file defines the C6X operand constraints used by the RTL patterns, covering register files, predicate and special registers, immediate encodings, symbolic references, and memory-address forms. Its constraint predicates distinguish A/B register banks, small signed and unsigned constant ranges, valid masks, GP-relative small-data references, call operands, and aligned or special memory forms, directly guiding reload, instruction matching, and operand legality for the backend.
